t: An interactive lab for strategy games and artificial intelligence

Enjoy playing Tic-Tac-Toe, the Prisoner's Dilemma, or a grid maze while adjusting the number of players, play mode, and Minimax, Alpha-Beta, Monte Carlo, and Q-learning algorithms directly in your browser.
A strategy game experience with smart algorithms

This lab lets you try strategy games with advanced AI algorithms. You can choose a game, set the number of players and play mode, then watch results in real time on the chart. The app supports Minimax, Alpha-Beta, Monte Carlo, and Q-learning to generate optimal policies and display decision trees and learning curves in the browser with no server required.
Yes, all algorithms run locally in your browser and do not require any external requests.
What is the difference between "Turn-based" and "Simultaneous" modes?
In "Turn-based" mode, each player takes turns sequentially, while in "Simultaneous" mode, all moves are calculated in the same round.
Can the AI algorithm be modified?
The app provides built-in ready-to-use algorithms, and developers can modify the source code if they want to try other algorithms.
